divergences.description: Terminal UI: tj3 prints the GPL banner (11 lines) and a \r progress bar; the CLI prints the project summary (24.4.5).
divergences.justification: Product surface, not engine behavior; both are filtered and the stdout residue must be empty on both sides.
divergences.mitigation: Residue comparison after filtering (cli-tj3.rb#strip_banner, golden runner#residue).

divergences.description: accountreport balance mode: tj3 closes the list with a Total row (temporary Account adopting cost/revenue accounts) and numbers each list from zero; the port does not emit the row.
divergences.justification: Report serialization gap, not a scheduling or parsing divergence.
divergences.mitigation: compare downgraded to artifacts (exit + inventory); exits with the full report golden.

divergences.description: CSV cell marshaling: (a) integral Float prints 4.0 in Ruby vs 4 in the port; (b) empty cell prints "" in Ruby vs empty in the port; (c) error cell prints "" in Ruby vs <Error> in the port.
divergences.justification: Representation differences in CSVFile#marshal; byte-exact parity fixtures only use text/date/percent columns.
divergences.mitigation: Parity fixtures restricted to id/name/start/end/priority/complete/index columns; exits with the full report golden.

divergences.description: Warning sets differ: the port emits priority_inversion and *_check_unsupported during schedule() (Ruby only evaluates them with the query engine); Ruby emits no_reports and an extra missing-balance warning that the port does not.
divergences.justification: Only the first message of error fixtures is compared; messages elsewhere are informational.
divergences.mitigation: First-message comparison on error fixtures (24.7.8).

divergences.description: HTML envelope: tj3 <head> carries description/keywords; the css <link>, the generated-by comment and the copyright line are product-specific.
divergences.justification: The envelope is product surface; the payload is the <body>.
divergences.mitigation: Canonical DOM: body only, ID<n>/<TS> stabilized on both sides.

divergences.description: Gantt geometry (bar positions, arrows, nowLineX) is not compared by the CLI golden.
divergences.justification: Dedicated coverage exists in the Phase 15 gantt golden (1px tolerance, frozen now).
divergences.mitigation: scripts/golden/gantt-common.rb + gantt_golden_test.ts.

divergences.description: Spurious task_start_in_parent on deliveries.start: a milestone pinned to the project start is compared against the parent start and reported as before it with the same printed date. CLI exits 1 with no artifacts; tj3 exits 0.
divergences.justification: Core scheduler divergence (toSeconds comparison); pre-existing, also ignored in cli.integration_test.ts.
divergences.mitigation: Excluded from the e2e subset; wave-1 exit promises reconciliation of Project.schedule() with Project.rb.

divergences.description: effort 20m (20 months) with two group allocations overflows the project time frame in the port (173.5d of effort does not fit) but not in tj3. A single-resource task passes; group competition breaks.
divergences.justification: Core scheduler divergence in group allocation competition.
divergences.mitigation: Excluded from the e2e subset; wave-1 scheduler reconciliation target.

divergences.description: resourcereport "." makes tj3 write the HTML to stdout; the port with --output-dir always writes to disk.
divergences.justification: Output policy difference ("." is a directory, not a file); leaves coverage exists in scripts/golden/leaves.rb.
divergences.mitigation: Excluded from the e2e subset; architectural, remains.

divergences.description: CSV report content on stdout: D3 cell marshaling (integral floats, empty/"" and <Error> cells), date rendering (plain vs long form), unexpanded query-attribute cells ([object Object], <-query->) and scheduling values; the whole group is report output not yet reconciled.
divergences.justification: Report serialization + output-policy divergence (D3 family), not parsing; stdout residue is always compared so a downgrade cannot silence it.
divergences.mitigation: Excluded as a group; exits with the full report golden (D2/D3).

divergences.description: Message-only normalizations (F21 26.5): date renderings (TjTime long form, plain ISO, JS ctime) canonicalize to a UTC instant; integral floats collapse (4.0 → 4); the leading source location (<PATH>:12:) is stripped (tj3 omits it on runtime errors); the report progress meter (Report …) is filtered on both sides.
divergences.justification: Representation, not behavior: the instant, the value and the message text are still compared; only the rendering is canonicalized symmetrically in the oracle and the harness.
divergences.mitigation: normalizeMessage (e2e-harness.ts) × normalize_message (cli-tj3.rb); unit-tested.
